description: This file defines a class 'BlackfireDumper' in the Twig\Profiler\Dumper namespace. The class is responsible for dumping profiling data in the Blackfire format, including methods to traverse and serialize profiling information from 'Profile' objects into a specific text format suitable for Blackfire.

classes.name: BlackfireDumper
classes.description: A final class responsible for converting profiling data into a Blackfire-compatible dump format. Implements methods to recursively process profiling profiles and generate a formatted string.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Public method that initiates the profiling dump process, returning a string formatted for Blackfire, including calling internal methods to process profile data.

methods.name: dumpChildren
methods.description: Private recursive method that traverses child profiles to include nested profiling data.

methods.name: dumpProfile
methods.description: Private method to gather statistics from a profile and record it into the data array.
